integrity: Scientific statement uses finite exact Frobenius-orbit enumeration and a separately justified normalization/cycle-lattice proof; the attached checker reproduces the finite tables. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on an Eckardt-free smooth cubic surface arising from a Galois-stable reduced six-point blowup, with characteristic >=5. No claim about other W(E6) forms, existence in every finite field, or a full integral torus isomorphism classification. Split-case counts and the line-intersection graph are known. Historical priority subject to independent examination.
title: Eleven Frobenius zeta functions of the \(27\)-line boundary on six-point cubic surfaces
